I finished a few years of school so I can read what is on the bag, but I farm the way my mother taught me. My wheat plot is only 0.16 hectares, so last season I shared a 50-kilo bag of DAP with my neighbor and I will do the same this year. That gives me about 25 kilos for my plot, which is roughly 30 kilograms of nitrogen for each hectare. I will also put cow manure on this plot because it is my own land and I have two cows at home. I will plant my own saved seed, not the improved one from the cooperative, because the improved seed costs too much and I did not see my cousin's wheat do much better with it last year. I will not spray any chemical — I weed by hand. We do not irrigate wheat in our area; we depend on the meher rains. My sister and I will work about 20 days on this plot from planting to harvest, and I will not hire any outside labor because the plot is small and I need to save my money.
